Integration Process: Test integration when an admin suspends a member, the member's session stops being accepted
Pre-condition: Member is signed in and not suspended; an admin is signed in
Expected Result: Verify the member is treated as a signed-in non-admin (403) before and as signed out (401) after the suspension

Integration Process: Test integration when an admin lifts a suspension, the member's access returns
Pre-condition: Member is suspended indefinitely; an admin is signed in
Expected Result: Verify the member is refused as signed out (401) while suspended and accepted again as a signed-in member (403 for admin pages) after the lift

Integration Process: Test integration when an admin suspends the same member twice, the first suspension is remembered
Pre-condition: Member is already suspended by an earlier request
Expected Result: Verify the second request is refused with 409 ALREADY_SUSPENDED and only one suspension is stored

Integration Process: Test integration when a member is suspended, lifted and suspended again, the suspension level and audit trail follow
Expected Result: Verify levels 1 and 2 are recorded and the audit log reads USER_SUSPENDED, USER_UNSUSPENDED, USER_SUSPENDED in order

Integration Process: Test integration when a suspended member tries to sign in, the refusal carries what the admin entered
Pre-condition: An admin suspended the member for 7 days with the reason 'Spam listings'
Expected Result: Verify the 403 body has code ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED with the same reason, level 1 and an end date about 7 days ahead

Integration Process: Test integration when two admins mark the same report as 'reviewing', the second is told it is already being reviewed
Expected Result: Verify the first request moves the report to REVIEWING with one audit entry and the second is refused with 409

Integration Process: Test integration when an admin's role is removed while still signed in, the next request is refused
Pre-condition: Admin is signed in and has just used the admin pages
Expected Result: Verify the first request passes the gate and, after the role changes to member, the same session is refused with 403

Integration Process: Test integration when people behind a trusted proxy sign up, each address gets its own rate limit
Pre-condition: Requests arrive through Cloudflare from two different addresses and the limit is 3 per hour
Expected Result: Verify the first address is blocked on its 4th request while the second address is still allowed
